newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record high, Astra rises.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record high, Astra rises.

text.p: Swedish shares ended at record highs on Wednesday, boosted by strong U.S. trends and led by heavyweights drugs major Astra and telecoms group Ericsson.
The exchange's general index rose 1.21 percent to a record high of 2,835.85 in turnover of 6.46 billion crowns.
Astra kept gaining after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) updated its approved list with another three patents for Astra's blockbuster anti-ulcer agent Losec on Tuesday.
The share jumped 7.5 crowns to 344 after surging 16.5 crowns a day earlier.
Ericsson benefited from closing higher in New York than in Stockholm on Tuesday, up seven to 273.5.
Dealers noted that engineering shares had been strong with Atlas Copco rising four crowns to 212.
"They are still supported by hopes about economic trends picking up in the second half of the year," a trader said.
Real estate companies also did well with construction and real estate group Skanska jumping five crowns to 333.
"Bond yields opened lower and the (real estate) shares have been lagging, so there could be some interest," a trader said.
